findings.title: Synthetic coverage finding must carry `location: unverified`
findings.description: Slice 904 requires every finding to carry `location:`, using `unverified` when no file citation applies. D4 instead explicitly gives the synthetic finding no location, and the frontmatter example likewise omits it. This is not merely presentational: the findings-addressed consumer treats a frontmatter finding without a location as malformed residue, so every imposed coverage CONCERN can become an unnecessary unresolved gate item. Construct the finding with `location: unverified` while retaining `location_verified = None`, and show that value in the artifact examples and rendering tests.

findings.title: Scope, dependency direction, and mechanism count align with the parent plan
findings.description: Parts A–C implement the three responsibilities assigned by slice-plan entry 25. The design retains the plan’s exclusions, defers diff ordering/`--stat` and other injection truncation to their named follow-ups, and chooses the permitted CONCERNS-cap outcome rather than failing the run. Routing provider observations through turn capture into `ReviewResult`, then through the shared persistence path, preserves dependency direction and gives CLI and pipeline artifacts structural parity. The two small new modules are justified by testability and the existing review-client size; no speculative configuration or unused abstraction is introduced.
